title: feat(context): implement ADR 0031 I6-A secure admission
body:
Implements ADR 0031 I6-A's local secure admission boundary: complete independent original Parent evidence, a total original Provider endpoint declaration, current service-bound authority before dependency lookup/replay, and policy leases held through actual commit. Both SQL Transfer fences remain intact. Provider/Context Exchange routes remain explicitly refused pending I6-C.

**Author validation is INCOMPLETE. Independent I6-A acceptance is NOT RUN.** Focused and installed checks pass, but the complete ordinary suite fails. No I6-B/C, I7/I8, normal Transfer activation or fence retirement is included.

### Exact ancestry and publication

- Base #141: `dc6e663ea90e55210ed5674cae6c332f66a4ac18`, tree `3d70218ecf98f751eb550e6a328a21f65069066f`, branch `review/adr0031-i6-design-independent-20261023`.
- Design #134: `418ee68046fdfd03a0e84cc840e5d52fce176b81`, tree `476d32923c9be5e3b60e4e17c8828e3646611c43`.
- Publication HEAD: `f5dc409429cdb69955b55e3c27a7ef3c163762fb`; tree `3ef434120202c6fa4cfaa1152802784a1671d3ed`.
- Final tested executable source: `770e42d4828238cc0001c96663d078605ac44841`, tree `9769a431eed95b841c9ac2d5a54a83ea248fc5be`. Later publication changes are evidence only; executable/test/configuration inputs are unchanged.
- Initial source `30888b6558f25d1a26092e020217d635b9c9a718` starts directly from #141; intermediate coordinator correction `cc6e611d366230438f2c25e4040156c90cf4897f` has its own separate receipts. Historical evidence was preserved.
- Task A #142 and #139 remain separate ancestry. ADR 0033 minimal-sdist implementation/review/repair and the receipt-limit fix are absent; later integration must reconcile those stacks. No merge/cherry-pick, prior-PR mutation, history rewrite, release, deployment or automation change.

### Product contracts and API

Domain/port: mandatory `ParentObservation`, `ProviderEndpointDeclaration`, pure dependency/original validators, exact service-issued `AdmissionContext`, local authorization/lease protocol and cumulative finite budgets. Adapters: guarded Store/Facade mutators, commit-owned transactions and coordinator capabilities, current mapping/Disposition/OID/Source checks, bounded scans, strict connection/schema profile, both exact fence definitions and expiring isolated fixture capability. Public input signatures require issued `admission`; application routes lacking trusted composition fail closed.

R01/R08/R09/R10–R16 and scoped R19 are implemented as mapped in MATRIX; R02–R07/R17 retain their inherited/scoped boundaries. I5-A1/B1/C1 and I6-L1 initial/replay counterexamples execute, including foreign allow-all service handles and forged principals before lookup with no foreign policy call or row delta. Parent 50/P/51 remains independent of Event 100/E/101. Missing originals, truncated two-sided reports, explicit null, unqualified dependencies and immutable replay conflicts are tested. Complete child-first Resource registration remains available.

I5-D1: an actual first endpoint INSERT succeeds (trace and in-flight 1 Event/1 endpoint), a trigger fails only the second INSERT, and rollback leaves 0/0. Actual deferred FK COMMIT failure is followed by explicit transaction rollback; revision invalidation also leaves no partial rows while retaining charged work. I5-F1: normal, partial, mismatched, unreadable and absent fence states are checked; both packaged fences are unchanged. No new table/storage surrogate or permissive fallback.

### Actual Author results

| --- | --- | --- |

| Independently installed direct wheel | **551 PASS**, 35.131s | 0 |
| Independently installed sdist-derived wheel | **551 PASS**, 35.268s | 0 |
| Final serial SQL rollback/revocation probes | **3 PASS** | 0 |
| Frozen #141 historical 3137-node baseline | 3058 PASS / 59 FAIL / 20 ERROR | 1 |
| Frozen #141 complete ordinary baseline 5742 nodes | 5663 PASS / 59 FAIL / 20 ERROR | 1 overall |
| Final historical 3137 nodes | 2394 PASS / 324 FAIL / 419 ERROR | 1 |
| Final disjoint remainder 2804 nodes | 2804 PASS | 0 |
| **Final complete ordinary 5941 nodes** | **5198 PASS / 324 FAIL / 419 ERROR** | **1 overall** |

All final ordinary selected nodes execute exactly once; JUnit/journal starts match. Actual report-type sidecars reconcile ordinary phases and 57 passing unittest subtests. The inherited duplicate-call helper's false result remains visible; no blind deduplication, skips or xfails hide failures. Two collected live/benchmark nodes are explicitly unexecuted. Ruff check/format pass (435 files).

The initial ordinary run remains preserved: 5154 PASS / 341 FAIL / 424 ERROR across 5919 nodes. Recoverable coordinator lease/lifetime and exact-module audit regressions were fixed, with finite explicit coordinator fixture authority and all 63 original assertion ASTs retained (46 nodes pass). Final R12 denial/selection/native-ineligibility precedence was corrected after an actual 2 FAIL / 4 PASS counterexample; all six controls now pass. Final comparison resolves 22 initially unsuccessful historical nodes and introduces zero newly unsuccessful historical nodes.

**Remaining 743 nonsuccesses:** all 79 inherited nodes plus 664 additional nodes: 490 direct Store/Facade callers lack bound local authority; 47 coordinator callers lack explicit constructor/invocation authority; 127 actually reach unconnected I6-C Provider/Exchange guards. Per-node frames distinguish these categories; two caught assertions were diagnostically re-executed to capture their actual Provider guard. Fixture and real production composition must be reviewed separately; these failures do not establish downstream assertion success. All five initial ENOSPC-affected packaging nodes were safely rerun with workspace capacity; no final ENOSPC remains. The 79 inherited-node comparison records 21 call-to-setup phase shifts and all exception/assertion differences, rather than claiming equivalent behavior from equal counts.

CPython 3.12.14 uses its actual built-in SQLite 3.53.1 (full source ID in receipts); no extra SQLite engine, spoof or version matrix. Separate installed venvs/copies outside checkout prove import origin and source/wheel/installed file equality. All 471 measured executable/configuration inputs are unchanged across final execution; 156 product hashes match frozen Git bytes. Accepted ADRs, historical I5/I6 evidence, DDL and fingerprint inputs remain unchanged.

- Both wheel SHA-256: `83e9795875d58da753d7c9f76e9eb2c47e2eaafb70e079f581e59760ad5367c3`.
- Sdist SHA-256: `b5c7bac36796b73b9c3717881d5936706b8a01282a315aaf81f86b26db480de2` (84,133,424 bytes; inherited packaging contract).
- Installed Context fingerprint: `924cc7557fb3da6211ea070185881f5fcaeff9bf52b6e237a361a238a2ea0c6e`; both exact fences, integrity_check=ok, no FK-check rows.

Evidence: [REPORT](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/f5dc409429cdb69955b55e3c27a7ef3c163762fb/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6a/author/REPORT.md), [MATRIX](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/f5dc409429cdb69955b55e3c27a7ef3c163762fb/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6a/author/MATRIX.md), [commands/outcomes and limitations](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/f5dc409429cdb69955b55e3c27a7ef3c163762fb/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6a/author/VERIFICATION.md). New evidence directories contain actual commands, exits, JUnit/journals, node/phase/exception/assertion comparisons, SQL traces, source/product/DDL/fingerprint/archive hashes and compression bindings. Initial/bootstrap/interrupted/environment-failed runs are retained separately.

Hosted source `770e42d` checkpoint: offline/sqlite-policy PASS; registry-runtime FAIL. Hosted I4 217 and I5 29 PASS; its separate dynamic 3142-node historical selection reports 2399 PASS / 324 FAIL / 419 ERROR, exit 1. The inherited Access installed smoke scripts fail on unbound Context authority, separately from our 551-node installed lanes. Hosted uses its actual Python 3.12.15 / SQLite 3.53.1. Line-numbered log excerpts and exact checkpoint are retained; a redirected CLI log download failed Forbidden, while the connector log read succeeded. Final publication check status is reported separately below, without calling the runtime green.

Next non-Author I6-A review must freeze publication HEAD/tree, rerun service/principal attacks, current authorization/replay/revocation, exact original evidence and commit/SQL rollback, both fence states and installed artifacts; inspect the broad failed-node disposition and unexecuted assertions. Remaining fixture authority migration is engineering work; activating real Provider/Exchange composition requires separately scoped I6-C work. No independent PASS, full regression acceptance, merge or release is claimed.

### Verified final publication

At 2026-10-23T03:31:38.546255+00:00, remote commit, branch and PR head all match `f5dc409429cdb69955b55e3c27a7ef3c163762fb`, tree `3ef434120202c6fa4cfaa1152802784a1671d3ed`. Base #141/tree are exact, PR is OPEN/DRAFT/unmerged, and the worktree is clean. GitHub CI merge commit `dbb523026aa9b9c30bdee67dff72c58b2efba440` has exact parents base/head and the identical publication tree. These are read-only verifications; no merge was performed.

Final-head CI: **registry-runtime: IN_PROGRESS; sqlite-policy: SUCCESS; offline: SUCCESS**. Registry runtime remains pending at this snapshot; the source770 runtime FAILURE above remains visible and no runtime PASS is inferred.

An additional final-HEAD rebuild (`git archive f5dc409429cdb69955b55e3c27a7ef3c163762fb`, then `python -m hatchling build -t wheel -t sdist`, then `python -m hatchling build -t wheel` from the freshly extracted sdist; all exit0) produced direct and sdist-derived wheels that are both bit-identical to the independently installed551PASS wheels: 777,748 bytes, SHA-256 `83e9795875d58da753d7c9f76e9eb2c47e2eaafb70e079f581e59760ad5367c3`. No repeated runtime result is invented from this identity check. The final publication sdist has 4361 members, 92,564,790 bytes, SHA-256 `47cf44c5c3a2cb2b0504acd0c3da585e3db0c9fce531bfc911351557bb63f0b5`. Its added evidence members explain the archive difference from the tested source770 sdist; product wheel bytes remain identical.
